A cafe has 3 old snack choices and 4 new snack choices. It also has 2 hot drinks and 3 cold drinks. How many snack-drink combinations are possible?
Hints: There are 3 + 4 snacks and 2 + 3 drinks;Multiply the totals
Solution: There are 7 snack choices and 5 drink choices, so there are 7 × 5 = 35 combinations.
